## Type of change

- [ ] Feature (new capability)

- [ ] Hotfix (urgent production fix)

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm test` passes locally (lint + typecheck + unit tests)
- [ ] TypeScript strict — no `any` casts added without a comment explaining why
- [ ] No `console.log` left in production paths
- [ ] No hardcoded credentials, secrets, or environment-specific values
- [ ] Tested locally against Team Test / dev environment
- [ ] `COORDINATION.md` updated if files were claimed or released
- [ ] Migration added and documented if the database schema changed
